# 020-hotel

**Provider.** Airbnb, short-term rental of a whole flat, English (UK formats).

**Format.** Email with HTML and text parts. Airbnb layout: no header bar, a large headline, a listing card with check-in and checkout columns, a stacked list of address, guests, confirmation code and cancellation policy, a host block, payment details with fee lines and the card charge, and house rules.

**Why.** There is no hotel name: the listing title ("Sunny loft with river view in Alfama") is the property name and title, and the listing type ("Entire rental unit") serves as the room. The host is named but is not a traveller; only the guest addressed in the headline is. The total includes the Airbnb service fee, cleaning fee and tourist tax, and the nightly rate line ("€185.00 x 4 nights") must not be taken as the total. Times appear as bare "16:00" and "11:00" under the dates and again in the house rules. The cancellation policy uses dates without a year ("10 Jul") that the extractor must leave as written. No phone number is printed.
